title: Hill Numbers for LLM Output Diversity: An Ecology-Borrowed Effective-Diversity Metric

original_idea.body:
# Hill Numbers for LLM Output Diversity

Import Hill numbers from ecology; embed and cluster LLM responses into response species and compute order-0/1/2 diversity across a panel of open models on Infinity-Chat plus safety prompts, reporting effective number of distinct response modes. Embeddings + clustering.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (standardized diversity metric aids monitoring) but the catastrophic link is methodological.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: embed, cluster, compute Hill numbers; well-documented inherited framework, novice+mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused metric deliverable with embedding/clustering as dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: foundational monitoring metric from public models, no internal access, labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Applying Hill numbers to LLM output diversity appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known application of Hill numbers to LLM output diversity.
